customManagers.description: Versions built from source in the Dockerfile, marked with a renovate comment above their ARG.

packageRules.description: PHP_VERSION is the oldest supported PHP, not a version to chase. CI overrides it per matrix entry.
PHPUnit 12 needs PHP 8.3 and 13 needs 8.4. Lift this when the PHP floor moves.
utopia-php/console 0.2.9 and later need PHP 8.5, so the 8.2 lock can never install them.
Only tagged FFmpeg releases, not the -dev tags cut at the start of each cycle.
The IDE helper describes the extension the tests run against, so the two move together.
